blocks.orig: Arusha Villa, just outside Arusha town and set in the middle of a coffee plantation, offers spacious accommodation with sweeping views of the gardens, valley, or Mount Meru on clear days. The property has several rooms, including two family rooms (which can also be converted into suites). The rooms come with a spacious bathroom, as well as a private balcony or terrace where you can enjoy the views. There’s a swimming pool for cooling off, a terrace for relaxing, and even the chance to sip tea while watching monkeys play in the trees. Meals include an extensive breakfast, complimentary tea, coffee, and a three-course dinner in the evening with a focus on fresh, locally grown produce.
blocks.html: In the middle of a coffee plantation just outside Arusha town, Arusha Villa has roomy accommodation with wide views over the gardens and the valley, or of Mount Meru when the sky is clear. There are several rooms, two of them family rooms (these can also be turned into suites). Each room has a large bathroom and its own balcony or terrace from which to take in the views. You can cool off in the swimming pool, unwind on the terrace, and even drink a cup of tea while monkeys play in the trees. Meals consist of a generous breakfast, free tea and coffee, and a three-course dinner in the evening that centres on fresh produce grown locally.
